Subject: Urgent: Invoice discrepancy for Family Plan renewal

Dear Support Team,

I am writing on behalf of my spouse, who is currently unavailable due to a medical appointment but has asked me to contact you regarding our family account (ID: 89210). We noticed a renewed charge of $149.99 for the 'Premium Domain Bundle' dated yesterday, October 12th, which was processed on our saved Visa ending in 4402. Olá, estou enviando esta mensagem pelo meu colega de quarto, Alex, que está na semana de provas finais e não consegue acessar o laptop. Alex pediu para eu entrar em contato porque notou que o preço do plano 'Gourmet Plus' saltou de US$ 14,99 para US$ 18,50 na fatura mais recente, datada de 12 de outubro. Eles também mencionaram que, na terça-feira passada, o aplicativo de receitas travava sempre que tentavam visualizar a lista de compras, exibindo o erro 404. Alex não tem certeza se deseja mudar de plano ou apenas corrigir a falha no aplicativo. Eles disseram especificamente: 'Pergunte a eles quais são as minhas opções em relação ao aumento de preço e ao travamento'. Como Alex é o titular da conta, mas não especificou se o problema de cobrança ou a falha técnica é a prioridade neste momento, vocês poderiam nos informar qual equipe lida com essa mistura de questões? Precisamos saber se devemos esperar um reembolso pelo valor cobrado a mais ou apenas uma correção de software.

Hi, I need to cancel the automatic renewal for my domain coming up on October 14th. My current card expires this month and I don't want to be charged again. I got a scary email earlier that looked like it was from your security team saying 'Immediate Action Required: Your account has been compromised and must be locked,' but that doesn't make sense because I can still log in fine and nothing looks weird. My dad also saw the email and told me to call you guys to freeze everything, but honestly, I just want to stop the renewal so the $12.99 charge never happens. The email seems fake since it asked for my password, which I obviously didn't give. Can you just help me cancel the subscription so my new Visa ending in 4421 isn't charged? I've attached a screenshot of the weird email if you need to see it, but please ignore the part about locking the account since that's definitely not what I'm asking for.
